constraints.name: end_user_identity_owners_environment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.subject_ownership_namespaces(environment_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: end_user_subject_reservations_environment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.subject_ownership_namespaces(environment_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: subject_reservations_owner_environment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id, environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.end_user_identity_owners(owner_id, environment_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: end_users_environment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.environments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: environments_active_configuration_version_same_environment_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, active_configuration_version_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.configuration_versions(environment_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: environments_issuer_host_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((issuer_host = lower(issuer_host)) AND (POSITION(('://'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('/'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('?'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0) AND (POSITION(('#'::text) IN (issuer_host)) = 0)))

constraints.name: environments_tenant_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.tenants(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_identifiers_environment_id_registration_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, registration_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.lti_registrations(environment_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_launch_intents_environment_id_registration_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, registration_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.lti_registrations(environment_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_launch_intents_registration_id_revision_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (registration_id, revision) REFERENCES aegaeon.lti_registration_revisions(registration_id, revision) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_registration_revisions_author_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (author_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.administrators(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_registration_revisions_registration_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (registration_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.lti_registrations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_active_revision_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (id, active_revision) REFERENCES aegaeon.lti_registration_revisions(registration_id, revision) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

constraints.name: lti_registrations_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (((active_revision IS NULL) OR ((active_revision > 0) AND (active_revision <= revision))))

constraints.name: lti_registrations_client_record_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (client_record_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.clients(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: lti_registrations_environment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.environments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: subject_ownership_adoptions_environment_id_kind_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, kind) REFERENCES aegaeon.subject_ownership_namespaces(environment_id, origin) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: subject_ownership_adoptions_shape
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((kind = 'fresh'::text) AND (maintenance_reference IS NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NULL) AND (inventory_sha256 IS NULL) AND (receipt_data IS NULL)) OR ((kind = 'legacy'::text) AND (maintenance_reference IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (inventory_sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (manifest_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (inventory_sha256 ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text) AND (receipt_data IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: subject_ownership_namespaces_environment_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.environments(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: user_attribute_sources_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((source_kind = 'LOCAL'::text) AND (source_namespace = 'local'::text) AND (connection_id IS NULL)) OR ((source_kind = 'EXTERNAL'::text) AND (connection_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_namespace = ('connection:'::text || (connection_id)::text)))))

constraints.name: user_attribute_sources_environment_id_connection_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, connection_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.connections(environment_id, id)

constraints.name: user_attribute_sources_environment_id_end_user_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (environment_id, end_user_id) REFERENCES aegaeon.end_users(environment_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
